this_record_executes_nothing: THIS FILE RUNS NOTHING. It is a governance record. Execution happens only when the frozen command below is invoked separately, exactly once, after the architect authorises it internally.

authorisation_state.user_authorisation: GRANTED, as the standing authorisation to proceed to training-ready
authorisation_state.architect_authorisation: PENDING - the architect reviews this readiness bundle and authorises execution internally

authority.user_authorisation_text_verbatim: ok allora autorizzo a procedere. vorrei che arrivassi a training ready, utilizza claude e fagli usare subagenti paralleli per velocizzare il lavoro se lo ritieni utile
authority.user_addition_verbatim: alla fine di ogni fase scrivui un user report
authority.scope_of_that_authorisation: the standing authorisation covers proceeding TOWARDS training-ready. It is a direction of travel, not a blanket grant: each stage remains subject to the architect's gate.
authority.architect_decision: apply the July MULTISTART METHODOLOGY exclusively to the August V26 lineage. Taken by the architect, explicitly, and implemented here without alteration.
authority.architect_role: gate owner and reviewer; the architect authorises this execution internally after reviewing the readiness bundle
authority.assistant_role: operator. Executes exactly what this file freezes, once, and nothing else.
authority.ppo_is_not_authorised_to_start: PPO is NOT authorised to start, nor is a critic warm-up, nor the fit that will eventually consume this data. Reaching training-ready is a PRECONDITION for them, never a permission to begin them.

what_is_authorised.description: one invocation of the frozen J10 runner, collecting exactly two prescribed-teacher rollouts of 500 steps at the two non-nominal start offsets, in the order B then C, into the single frozen leaf
what_is_authorised.retry: NONE. Whatever the outcome, there is no second attempt, no alternate leaf, no changed argument and no autonomous recovery.
what_is_authorised.parallel_subagents: permitted for READ-ONLY audit work only. The collection itself is SINGLE and is never duplicated, delegated or run concurrently.

operational_parent.role: the August V26 imitative actor. It fixes the lineage and is NEVER the action source; it is not loaded at any point.
operational_parent.j8_student_excluded: the J8 student is never a parent, never a policy and never a label source in this stage

label_source.invariant: executed_actions == actions, bit for bit, because sigma is exactly zero

frozen_execution.no_progress_flag: NOT passed; per-cell progress is surfaced
frozen_execution.no_other_flag: no flag may be added, removed or altered
frozen_execution.capture: stdout, stderr and the exit code are captured fail-closed to files. Capture is redirection only and cannot cause a second attempt.

immediately_before_execution.recheck_the_frozen_hashes: byte-for-byte against both hash maps above
immediately_before_execution.rerun_the_preflight: must be GO, with no blockers
immediately_before_execution.reconfirm_absence: no J10 leaf, no lock, no staging, no sentinel
immediately_before_execution.on_any_mismatch: DO NOT EXECUTE. Stop and report.

behavioural_or_coverage_fail.expected_state: the leaf IS COMMITTED with the full evidence and verdict FAIL; the process exits non-zero
behavioural_or_coverage_fail.action: PRESERVE the evidence, write the phase report, STOP and diagnose. No retry.

technical_or_integrity_error.expected_state: NO leaf is committed; staging and lock removed; concurrent content survives

pass.expected_state: the leaf is committed with verdict PASS; the process exits 0
pass.action: PRESERVE, write the phase report, hand back to the architect
pass.confers_nothing: a PASS produces a dataset. It authorises no fit, no critic, no PPO, no promotion and no next stage.

a_pass_does_not_authorise: the fit that will consume this data
any change to FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA or the C++ plugin
this_authorisation_does_not: modify the runner, the preregistration or the tests
modify any J0-J9R1 artefact, July source, report or production configuration
grant a second attempt under any circumstance
permit a different leaf, interpreter, cwd or argv
